NPC_TAMSIN.body_proportions: slim athletic adult; long forearms; compact stance

hair.shape: angular layered crop with a heavy left-side fringe

NPC_TAMSIN.default_outfit: charcoal municipal utility jacket over a pale work shirt with dark work trousers
role_markers: small municipal systems badge on left chest
forbidden_deviations: do not remove the eyebrow notch
do not replace the cross-body tool satchel with a backpack

QUEST_DEAD_RELAY.title: The Dead Relay
QUEST_DEAD_RELAY.description: Recover the impossible relay signal and decide what Gate Twelve means for the evacuation.

QUEST_GATE_TWELVE_ECHO.title: Gate Twelve Echo
QUEST_GATE_TWELVE_ECHO.description: Investigate the signal below Gate Twelve and learn what it does before relying on it.

QUEST_TRACE_STABILIZATION.title: Trace Stabilization
QUEST_TRACE_STABILIZATION.description: Train Trace Echo through repeatable sessions, recovery, and controlled technique growth.

QUEST_PLATFORM_NINE_RECORDS.title: Platform Nine Records
QUEST_PLATFORM_NINE_RECORDS.description: Read the old municipal evacuation records and learn why maintenance routes remain accessible during blackouts.

OPENING_DEPOT_BLACKOUT.title: The Last Light in Platform Nine
OPENING_DEPOT_BLACKOUT.body: The district blackout reaches the tram depot before the evacuation order does. Emergency strips burn red along the floor. A maintenance courier lies conscious beside a dead relay case, too injured to carry it farther. Tamsin, a systems apprentice, is trying to keep the depot doors powered long enough for the remaining passengers to leave.

choices.text: Take responsibility for the relay case.

OPENING_RELAY_CASING.title: A Case That Should Be Empty
OPENING_RELAY_CASING.body: The relay is an obsolete municipal model. Its outer casing is cold, but a faint status pulse repeats from inside. The address plate has been physically scraped away.

choices.text: Use the maintenance seal to open the casing without damaging it.
Force the damaged casing and risk destroying the remaining signal.

OPENING_RECOVERY.title: One More Person Has to Know
OPENING_RECOVERY.body: The relay's pulse is gone. Tamsin notices the change immediately. Recovering the destination now means admitting what you were trying to do.

choices.text: Show Tamsin the damaged relay and ask her to recover its last address handshake.

OPENING_DECISION.title: Gate Twelve
OPENING_DECISION.body: The destination resolves to Service Gate Twelve, a sealed maintenance entrance below the depot. The official evacuation route runs in the opposite direction. The next decision is not only whether to go below, but whether Tamsin becomes part of what happens there.

choices.text: Tell Tamsin about Gate Twelve and ask her to come with you.
Keep the destination private and leave for Gate Twelve alone.
Ask Tamsin to come with you now that she knows the route.
Ask Tamsin to stay with the evacuees while you go to Gate Twelve alone.

OPENING_TUNNEL.title: Below the Evacuation Route
OPENING_TUNNEL.body: Tamsin kills the emergency panel, pockets her reader, and follows you beneath the platform. Gate Twelve opens onto a service tunnel that is supposed to have been sealed for years. Fresh boot prints cross the dust.

choices.text: Enter the tunnel together.

OPENING_SOLO_EXIT.title: The Quiet Stair
OPENING_SOLO_EXIT.body: You wait until Tamsin turns back to the passengers, then slip through the maintenance stair alone. The relay case feels heavier once nobody else knows where you are going.

choices.text: Descend toward Gate Twelve alone.

OPENING_END.title: Gate Twelve: The First Echo
OPENING_END.body: The relay case has brought you to the threshold of something the municipal records do not explain. Your route, party composition, Tamsin's knowledge, and the choices that got you here remain persistent.

choices.text: Ask Tamsin what she makes of entering Gate Twelve together.
Continue below Gate Twelve.
Return to the district first. Gate Twelve can wait.

POWER_GATE_TWELVE_SIGNAL.title: A Signal With No Receiver
POWER_GATE_TWELVE_SIGNAL.body: Below Gate Twelve, the dead relay begins to pulse against your palm. Tamsin's diagnostic reader sees no carrier frequency. You do. The sensation is not a voice or a message; it is a spatial afterimage, as if recent energy use has left a pressure pattern in the metal around you.

choices.text: Focus on the afterimage instead of forcing it to make sense.

data.description: Perceives residual patterns left by recent energy or signal activity.

POWER_FIRST_PRACTICE.title: One Hour, No Shortcut
POWER_FIRST_PRACTICE.body: The first impression is not control. When you try to reproduce the sensation deliberately, it slips away. The only useful option is practice: repeat the same narrow exercise, stop when your focus drops, and record what changes.

choices.text: Spend one hour practicing the same narrow pulse-sensing exercise.

POWER_FIRST_PRACTICE_RESULT.title: A Method Instead of a Shortcut
POWER_FIRST_PRACTICE_RESULT.body: The first controlled use gives you a baseline, not an upgrade. To make Trace Echo useful at direction-finding range, you need three things: stabilize Signal Pulse through repetition, understand which trace patterns remain consistent, and condition yourself to tolerate the sensory load.

choices.text: Begin a structured Trace Echo stabilization plan.

POWER_FIRST_LIVE_USE.title: A Pulse You Can Finally Hold
POWER_FIRST_LIVE_USE.body: Practice has not made Trace Echo reliable, but the pattern now lasts long enough to test once. The dead relay is the safest target: familiar, contained, and already tied to the signal that triggered the ability.

choices.text: Use Signal Pulse once on the dead relay and stop if the strain spikes.

POWER_TRACE_STRAIN.title: The Cost of Listening Too Closely
POWER_TRACE_STRAIN.body: The pulse resolves into a short-lived directional impression, then your ordinary senses feel overexposed. The useful information remains, but so does a temporary sensory strain. Quiet recovery restores the ability-specific reserve slowly.

choices.text: Spend thirty quiet minutes recovering before trying anything else.

TRACE_STABILIZATION_HUB.title: Trace Echo Training Ledger
TRACE_STABILIZATION_HUB.body: Progress is measured in sessions, recovery, and reproducible results. Signal Pulse can be practiced, the general Powers skill can be trained, and recovery is necessary when Focus or Stamina runs low. The research options only become useful after the technique itself has stabilized.

choices.text: Practice Signal Pulse for two focused hours.
Train two hours of controlled power fundamentals and measurement.
Stop training and recover for eight hours.
Compare the relay and Gate Twelve traces until the repeatable pattern becomes clear.
Complete a six-hour sensory tolerance protocol using short pulses, darkness, and controlled recovery.
Use the stabilized pattern to derive Directional Trace.

TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_DISCOVERY_RESULT.title: Direction, Not Mastery
TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_DISCOVERY_RESULT.body: Directional Trace is finally reproducible enough to exist as a technique, but it begins at zero mastery. The next safe step is one controlled attempt against the service fork below Gate Twelve, where the earlier trace is already documented.

choices.text: Attempt one controlled Directional Trace on the service fork.

TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_AFTERSHOCK.title: A Stronger Echo, A Stronger Cost
TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_AFTERSHOCK.body: The directional impression is clearer than Signal Pulse, but the strain is immediately worse. The trace points deeper below the mapped service level. You stop before repeating the technique and let the result stand on its own.

choices.text: Recover for one hour before ending the session.

TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_SESSION_END.title: A New Route, Not a Free Upgrade
TRACE_DIRECTIONAL_SESSION_END.body: Directional Trace is now real but still untrained. The first use produced actionable information, consumed a large share of Trace Resonance, and caused heavier sensory strain. Future progress will require practice, recovery, and decisions about whether to follow the deeper route.

choices.text: Record the result and return to the district.

DISTRICT_HUB.title: The District Opens Up
DISTRICT_HUB.body: When you return above the service level, the blackout has changed the rhythm of the district rather than ending it. The depot plaza is still under emergency lighting, but foot traffic has begun to spread again. A public archive is operating on backup power to the east, while the workshop row to the west has reopened its shutters. Nothing forces you to follow the deeper Trace route immediately; the district is available to explore.

choices.text: Read the temporary district notices before deciding where to go.
Return below Gate Twelve and continue the relay investigation.

DISTRICT_ARCHIVE.title: The Municipal Archive
DISTRICT_ARCHIVE.body: Rows of old municipal records glow under low backup lighting. Most files concern ordinary infrastructure, evacuation law, and maintenance budgets. A clerk has left the Platform Nine emergency-routing ledger open beside a battery lamp. It contains no supernatural revelation, but it explains why some sealed service routes remain powered when public corridors go dark.

choices.text: Read the Platform Nine emergency-routing ledger.
Cross-check the workshop rumor against old Gate Twelve maintenance bulletins.

DISTRICT_WORKSHOP.title: Workshop Row
DISTRICT_WORKSHOP.body: Repair crews have dragged benches into the open air where the emergency lamps are brighter. Broken readers, tram relays, and field tools are being sorted into salvage trays. The workers are more interested in keeping the district functional than in chasing rumors, but they have heard enough about Gate Twelve to know that municipal crews stopped using it long before tonight.

choices.text: Ask what the workshop crews remember about Gate Twelve.

KNOW_DIRECTIONAL_TRACE_POINTS_DEEPER.label: Directional Trace points deeper below Gate Twelve
KNOW_DIRECTIONAL_TRACE_POINTS_DEEPER.description: A controlled Directional Trace suggests the strongest recent residual path continues below the mapped service level.

KNOW_PLATFORM_NINE_EVAC_PROTOCOL.label: Platform Nine evacuation protocol
KNOW_PLATFORM_NINE_EVAC_PROTOCOL.description: Municipal records show that Platform Nine's emergency routing was deliberately designed to preserve maintenance access during district evacuations.

KNOW_GATE_TWELVE_CREW_WITHDRAWAL.label: Gate Twelve crew withdrawal
KNOW_GATE_TWELVE_CREW_WITHDRAWAL.description: Workshop recollections and archive maintenance bulletins agree that municipal crews stopped routine work at Gate Twelve earlier than public records suggest.

PERK_TRACE_TOLERANCE.label: Trace Tolerance
PERK_TRACE_TOLERANCE.description: Conditioned sensory control that improves effective Perception and Will while handling Trace Echo.
